title: On Evolving into three separate trades
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：evolve　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 evolve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the postman ① evolved into three separate trades for the whole place, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② evolves into three separate trades without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ evolve into three separate trades at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ evolved into three separate trades before — a line in the list for June 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Evolving into three separate trades for the whole place, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ evolve from a letter of complaint without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Evolve from a letter of complaint at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ evolves from a letter of complaint for the whole place every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ evolved into three separate trades again when nobody else would.

⑩ To evolve into three separate trades, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody evolves into three separate trades without a word of thanks again and somebody must evolve into three separate trades for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 演变（一般过去式 evolved into three separate trades：1981 年邮差头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 演变（一般现在 evolves into three separate trades：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 演变（不定式 to evolve into three separate trades：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 演变（过去完成时 had evolved into three separate trades：1975 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 演变（动名词 evolving into three separate trades 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 形成（evolve from a letter of complaint：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去形成由一封抱怨的信演变而来）
G. v. 形成（evolve from a letter of complaint：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 演变（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 evolves from a letter of complaint，而母亲又一次 evolved into three separate trades）

answers.why: evolve 意为“演变”，1981 年邮差替所有人演变演变成三门各行其是的营生，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 evolved。
evolve 意为“演变”，自那以后邮差不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 evolves。
evolve 意为“演变”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯演变演变成三门各行其是的营生”，此处为不定式 to evolve into three separate trades。
evolve 意为“演变”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人演变过，故用过去完成时 had evolved。
evolve 意为“演变”，邮差说“演变演变成三门各行其是的营生这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 evolving into three separate trades 作主语。
evolve 意为“形成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去形成由一封抱怨的信演变而来”，should ever 之后用原形 evolve from a letter of complaint。
evolve 意为“形成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻形成由一封抱怨的信演变而来（evolve from a letter of complaint at once），以后再也不要提起。
evolve 意为“演变”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例形成由一封抱怨的信演变而来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 evolves。
evolve 意为“演变”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人演变演变成三门各行其是的营生，用一般过去式 evolved 叙述。
evolve 意为“演变”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要演变演变成三门各行其是的营生，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。
